text: Kyra flips through the pages, deciphering its cryptic notes.
These entries… they’re so scattered, almost frantic.
His name is everywhere mentioned and signed on this Journal.. but.. why would it be hidden under.. the Captain’s pillow?
Says Kyra, giving the impression that Tom might have been a victim after the Captain and other passengers before him. She squints at the strange symbols and jumbled thoughts filling the pages.
What did the Captain and Tom know?
What did they investigate so desperately to end up writing this Journal full of.. cryptomessages?
How many other victims were involved into this very well-calculated chaotic nightmare?
